updates.background_zh: Postgres 本身已内置全文搜索，通过 tsvector、tsquery 和 ts_rank 等函数实现，并支持函数索引与查询优化，但不少开发者认为其相关性排序质量和索引体积不如专用搜索引擎。TIN 这类扩展正是瞄准这一差距，引入倒排索引和 BM25 打分算法——即 Lucene 推广、Elasticsearch 与 SQLite FTS5 采用的排序算法——从而让相关性排序更接近专用搜索引擎，同时数据仍留在 Postgres 内部。
updates.background_en: Postgres already ships built-in full-text search through the tsvector, tsquery and ts_rank functions, which support functional indexing and query optimization, but many developers find its ranking quality and index sizes limiting compared with dedicated search engines. TIN-style extensions target that gap by adding an inverted index and BM25 scoring — the ranking algorithm popularized by Lucene and used by Elasticsearch and SQLite's FTS5 — so relevance ordering behaves more like a purpose-built search engine while the data stays inside Postgres.
updates.community_discussion_zh: Hacker News 上的评论意见分化：质疑者认为 Postgres 已内置相当成熟的全文搜索（tsvector/tsquery/ts_rank），不明白为何要采用一个非核心、仅限云端的扩展，并提到 ts_query 索引体积过大的糟糕体验；也有人把这一波厂商搜索功能视为 AI 时代编码效率提升的体现。多位评论者指出本地版本只用于语法测试，且同类方案早已存在（ParadeDB pg_search、Timescale pg_textsearch、Neon/Databricks 的 Lakebase Search），还有人提到 SQLite FTS 开箱即支持 Lucene 风格查询，是 Postgres 尚未企及的参照。
updates.community_discussion_en: Hacker News commenters were split: skeptics asked why they should adopt a non-core, cloud-only extension when Postgres already has sophisticated built-in full-text search (tsvector/tsquery/ts_rank) and pointed to weak experiences with ts_query's large indexes, while others read the wave of vendor search features as a sign of AI-era coding productivity. Several noted the local version is syntax-only and that comparable alternatives already exist (ParadeDB pg_search, Timescale pg_textsearch, Neon/Databricks Lakebase Search), and one commenter highlighted SQLite FTS's Lucene-style queries as a benchmark Postgres has yet to match.
